title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: A solid 1973 performance with a stellar second‑set horn showcase, but the matrix recording is uneven and often muddy.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the tight playing and the spectacular second‑set sequence (Nobody's Fault → Eyes → Wharf Rat → Let It Grow) featuring the late‑'73 horn guests. While the musical show is praised as one of the era’s gems, several reviewers complain that the audience/soundboard mix is muddy, with a particularly bad start, making the listening experience hit‑or‑miss.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated high (tight performance, standout second set), but recording quality receives mixed to negative feedback, lowering the overall weighted score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Many reviewers note a muddy, low‑fidelity audience/soundboard mix with an awful start; some mention occasional clarity but overall uneven sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight first set followed by a second‑set climax featuring the horn section; overall pacing praised despite early sound issues.
